Builder.Title: Magic Item Builder

Errors.WrongSystem: Procedural Magic Items needs the dnd5e system.
Errors.NoLibWrapper: Procedural Magic Items: libWrapper is not active. Some automated item effects will not work.
Errors.PropertyLoad: Procedural Magic Items: some property definitions couldn't be loaded. See the console (F12).
Errors.StaleStyles: Procedural Magic Items was updated, but your browser is still using its old stylesheet, so the builder will look wrong. Reload with the cache cleared: Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac), or Ctrl+F5 in the Foundry app.

BasePacks.Name: Base item sources
BasePacks.Label: Choose compendiums
BasePacks.Hint: Which compendiums the Magic Item Builder lists base items from, alongside PMI's built-in rings, amulets, cloaks, boots, gloves, belts, bracers, circlets, wands and rods. Only compendiums with usable mundane items are shown; the number is how many each has.
BasePacks.None: No compendiums with mundane weapons, armor, shields, wands, staves or rods were found.

SpellPacks.Name: Spell sources
SpellPacks.Label: Choose compendiums
SpellPacks.Hint: Which compendiums wand, staff and rod properties pick spells from. The number is how many spells each has. Items you've already created keep their spells.
SpellPacks.None: No compendiums with spells were found.

Triggers.ChargesRestored: {name} drinks in the moment of death and regains {count} charge(s).
